Round r1 blocker B1 is fixed and verified: Red case 8 now parses the logged JSON record and asserts role, missing, and reason 'preset' through toMatchObject, and this is the only committed Red-assertion change in the whole range. The r2 no-trim change in resolveRoleModel does not weaken fail-closed behavior: a blank or whitespace-only value still gives reason 'missing' (roles.ts:44-46), a preset is still rejected after a trimmed check (roles.ts:48-50), and the raw configured value flows only into the SDK chatRequest model string field with no injection surface. No repository file sets the flag, so the risk stays latent. Spec D9 keeps the no-PII rule. The Green r2 handoff and evidence.md defer this to S3 with a no-op debugLogger and a test. Default: fix in S3 as planned.

My grep confirms no production code matches either pattern. Default: the verifier records the test-file matches as the live complement of the artifact check; no action in S2.

The implementation uses a Map keyed by AiRole (providers.ts:399-402, :422), correct by inspection, and case 1 covers one role only. The Green r2 handoff defers this to S3. Default: add the two-role cache isolation test in S3, which edits the resolvers again.

N5 [Nit] review-b: No test feeds a padded preset value such as '  @preset/tutor  ' to resolveRoleModel. roles.ts:48-50 rejects it because the preset check trims first, and the trim behavior is proven by roles-preservation.test.ts:28-33, so the gap is a deterministic composition of two proven behaviors. Default: optional one-line case in the S3 test work; no action required for S2.
